summary: Repair bounded project-question retrieval, add locally verified explicit arithmetic, retain stable safe answer diagnostics and synchronize persisted page visual status.
decision_refs: User request on 2026-09-28 to repair the diagnosed CIRP answer-quality failures
Kapolei fixed-question comparison identifying retrieval and sibling-fragment grouping as the dominant sampled failure
approval_evidence: The user explicitly said to begin fixing the diagnosed trouble-log and answer-quality causes.
known_limitations: Visual Sheet metadata is used only as a page-routing hint; visual narration remains excluded and cannot ground an answer.

Arithmetic is limited to exact addition, subtraction, multiplication and division over cited plain numeric operands; date arithmetic, rounding, unit conversion and geometry inference remain unsupported.
This change has offline regression evidence and does not itself rerun the paid 633-page Kapolei benchmark.
